messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 — autoscaler failing in ap-east1. Observed `attachDenied` from cloud provider when trying to bind GPUs to nodes. Queue length: ~12k inference requests, latency spiking, some clients seeing 503s. Runbook: /runbooks/gpu-attach-failure. Notifying oncall and SRE Escalation.
Tom (oncall): ack — I'm on it. Gathering cluster logs and autoscaler metrics. Any immediate customer-impact notes?
Maria (support): started triage with top 3 affected customers, some seeing timeouts at 30s, others 429 rate-limit errors. Ramp-up started ~10m ago after a traffic spike.
Lee (infra): seeing persistent `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: attachDenied` from cloud API when we request GPUs. Quota reports show per-project GPU attach limit reached, not just regional pool.
Rachel (eng-ml): can we fall back to smaller model variants (half-precision) for hosted customers? We have a light model pool but it's in a different region (asia-south1).
Tom (oncall): plan: 1) temporarily route low-priority traffic to light pool, 2) failover selected customers to asia-south1, 3) request emergency quota increase with cloud support. Sequence: Lee to confirm attachDenied scope, Rachel to prepare routing change.
Lee (infra): confirm attachDenied is project-level hard limit. Cloud console shows no pending quota requests. I'll open emergency support ticket now and attach logs. Ticket #CLOUD-9572.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: bridge created -> https://pd.example/bridge/abc123. Severity P1.
SRE Escalation: I'll join bridge. Tom, runbook step 2 suggests draining new node requests to allow reattach attempts — we may need a manual node provisioning workaround.
Tom (oncall): I'm running `kubectl cordon` on pending nodes and draining pods, then recreating with explicit accelerator attach hints. Pasting logs: ```Error: attachDenied: quota limit reached for resource gpu-v100 in project 12345```
Maria (support): Communicating to impacted customers: brief note posted to status.redwood.ai — we said we're investigating and implementing failover. Customers request ETA.
Rachel (eng-ml): I've staged a routing toggle: `feature-flag=light-fallback` to move non-SLA traffic to smaller models. Can flip in 30s if infra confirms safe.
Lee (infra): Support replied: emergency quota increase request accepted but ETA 2-3 hours. No faster manual override.
Tom (oncall): Flip routing now for non-SLA customers. Rachel, execute toggle. Maria, update customers with mitigation and ETA window.
Rachel (eng-ml): flipped `light-fallback` -> on. Non-critical traffic down 70% to light pool. Queue dropped from 12k -> 4.3k in ~2m. Latency improving for majority.
Maria (support): Posted customer update: "Mitigation in place: routing lower-priority traffic to alternate model pools. Working with cloud to increase GPU attach quota. Next update in 30 min."
SRE Escalation: Good progress. Next actions: monitor queue, prepare cross-region failover for critical customers if attachDenied persists after 15m, and start postmortem checklist. Assigning postmortem owner: Tom.
Tom (oncall): noted. Adding timeline and metrics to incident doc. If quota request ETA holds, we'll plan longer-term changes: pre-warmed spare projects, per-region capacity reservations.
Lee (infra): also creating an alert rule to detect project-level attach limits earlier. Putting runbook change in PR.
incident-bot: Automated metric snapshot saved to incident record. Closing note: Severity remains P1 until attachDenied cleared or full recovery.
Tom (oncall): leaving bridge to SRE Escalation for next shift; handing off at 6167900200. Everyone, thanks — great quick moves. :thumbsup:
